children: At a time when several blue-chip companies are struggling to create value for shareholders, eight companies have entered the elite ₹1 lakh crore market-cap club over the last year.

Crossing the ₹1 lakh crore market-cap milestone is a significant achievement for any company. While some companies, such as Paytm and Eternal, entered the club soon after listing, others have taken longer to reach the milestone.

The combined market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies has increased by around ₹27 lakh crore, or nearly 6%, over the last year to ₹484 lakh crore. A strong supply of IPOs has also contributed to the overall increase in market capitalisation. The achievement is particularly notable given that the benchmark Nifty 50 has declined more than 6% over the same period.
No. 1. Aditya Birla Capital | Current market cap: ₹1.10 lakh crore

Aditya Birla Capital joined the ₹1 lakh crore market-cap club in June this year. Shares of the Aditya Birla Group-owned financial services firm have gained 12% so far this year, after more than doubling last year.
No. 2. Bharat Forge | Current market cap: ₹0.93 lakh crore

Despite a 14% decline from its August peak, Bharat Forge shares are still up 33% so far this year. The company entered the ₹1 lakh crore market-cap club in June, but its current market capitalisation has since slipped to around ₹93,000 crore.
No. 3. GE Vernova T&D India | Current market cap: ₹1.16 lakh crore

Multiple contract wins in renewable energy, coupled with a robust order book, have driven shares of the power transmission and distribution equipment maker higher. The stock touched ₹5,650 on June 23, 2026.
Shares of GE Vernova T&D India are up 45% so far this year, making it one of the top performers on the Nifty 200 index.
No. 4. Hitachi Energy India | Current market cap: ₹1.39 lakh crore
Shares of Hitachi Energy India have rallied more than 70% so far in 2026. The company has also delivered positive returns every year since its 2020 listing.
The stock has attracted strong investor interest amid growing expectations around the data-centre theme.
No. 5. Indian Bank | Current market cap: ₹1.15 lakh crore
State-owned Indian Bank joined the elite ₹1 lakh crore market-cap club at the end of September 2025 and has managed to maintain its market capitalisation at around the same level.
No. 6. Laurus Labs | Current market cap: ₹1.05 lakh crore
Laurus Labs is the second-best performer on the Nifty 200 index so far in 2026, with a gain of 76%. Solar Industries India leads the index with an 83% gain.
Meanwhile, a strong performance in the June quarter prompted several analysts to raise their target prices for the stock.
No. 7. Lenskart Solutions | Current market cap: ₹1.21 lakh crore
Shares of Lenskart Solutions climbed to a record high of ₹703.75 on Thursday after ICICIdirect.com joined Nomura in initiating coverage on the stock with a “Buy” rating.
Of the 24 analysts tracking the stock on Bloomberg, 20 have a “Buy” rating. Three analysts recommend “Hold”, while Ambit Capital is the only brokerage with a “Sell” rating on the stock.
No. 8. Lloyds Metals & Energy | Current market cap: ₹1.02 lakh crore
Shares of Lloyds Metals & Energy are heading for their seventh consecutive year of positive returns in 2026.

The company manufactures sponge iron and also operates a cogeneration waste-heat recovery plant that recovers heat from its kilns. It reported its best-ever EBITDA margin of 39.2% in the June quarter.
The company is also planning to increase its capital expenditure to ₹15,000–20,000 crore over the next three years, compared with around ₹11,000 crore spent so far.

title: Eight companies enter ₹1 lakh crore market-cap club over the last year
